full_judgment: 6. It appears that the time of limitation of 180 days for completion of the departmental proceeding as prescribed in regulation 43(8) of the Employee's Service Regulation of the Port Authority, 1999 has been amended on 10-10-1994 and there is no embargo in holding the engaging proceeding beyond time and, as such, the allegation for non-completion of departmental proceeding within 180 days is not attracted in the present case and the penalty imposed by the Authority cannot be declared to have been passed and issued without any lawful authority.
